method_signature: public TransactionData execute(PlatformContext context, TransactionData data)

request_data_extractions.purpose: Extract the prioritized high-volume design blueprint tokens passed from the initial parsing phase.
Capture the primary tracking handle to append to the outbound execution payload response.

workflow_steps.code_snippet: com.google.common.collect.Multimap<String, Object> queryParams = com.google.common.collect.ArrayListMultimap.create(); queryParams.put("codes", top_three_configurations); context.streamDataFromDB("configuration", "byMultipleConfigCodes", queryParams, record -> { candidateSpecsList.add(record); });
workflow_steps.purpose: Batch pull key engineering profile specifications for each of the top three design configuration candidates.

workflow_steps.code_snippet: boolean modelsEqual = candidateSpecsList.stream().map(r -> String.valueOf(r.get("engine_model"))).distinct().count() == 1; double maxDisp = candidateSpecsList.stream().mapToDouble(r -> Double.parseDouble(String.valueOf(r.get("displacement_liters")))).max().orElse(0.0); double minDisp = candidateSpecsList.stream().mapToDouble(r -> Double.parseDouble(String.valueOf(r.get("displacement_liters")))).min().orElse(0.0); boolean varianceValid = (maxDisp - minDisp) < 4.0; if (!(modelsEqual && varianceValid)) { context.triggerExternalService("Criteria3Service", top_three_configurations); return data; }
workflow_steps.purpose: Evaluate engine model homogeneity and enforce strict bounds on volume variance before confirming resolution.

workflow_steps.code_snippet: com.google.common.collect.Multimap<String, Object> finalParams = com.google.common.collect.ArrayListMultimap.create(); finalParams.put("code", top_three_configurations.get(0)); context.streamDataFromDB("configuration", "byTop1ConfigCode", finalParams, record -> { resolvedSpecs.putAll(record); });
workflow_steps.purpose: Extract the complete set of six system descriptors from the primary high-volume design record.

conditional_routing.condition: all candidate engine model types match identically and the maximum displacement volume spread remains under four liters

scenarios.description: Verifies successful compilation and update of inventory component specs when model lines match and variance checks pass.
Verifies that an external routing sequence to Criteria 3 occurs if underlying engine architecture labels diverge.
Verifies that a routing redirection occurs if total displacement limits deviate by four or more liters.
